fact: Authorities plan to connect 300 more rural localities in 2026 after 500 villages equipped in the first year of the 2025 rural connectivity emergency programme; ITU data cited show 25.4% of rural residents using the internet in 2024 against 57% in urban areas.
title: Connectivité rurale : la Côte d'Ivoire cible 300 localités en 2026
